name: Chat Message
description:
Free-text Message for humans. Chat Message records text intended for
participants or auditors when no structured, machine-actionable Message type
is required.

As a Coordination/Message it supports requestId, inResponseTo, threadId, and
recipientChannel. recipientChannel directs attention but does not make the
Message private. A Chat Message may comment on a Request but never fulfils it;
only a Coordination/Response answers a Request, and only concrete operation
contracts perform actions.

message.description:
Textual content of the Message. Exact spelling, whitespace, and Unicode code
points are part of the Blue value.
